_comment: pi-blackhole config; auto compaction; GPT-6.1 Terra high observer; mixed-provider worker fallbacks.

observerModel._comment: OpenAI Codex GPT-6.1 Terra at high.

observerFallbackModels._comment: Non-Cursor fallback for observer; cheap/fast Google model.

reflectorModel._comment: OpenAI Codex GPT-6.1 Terra at high.

reflectorFallbackModels._comment: Non-Cursor fallback for reflector on another provider.

dropperModel._comment: OpenAI Codex GPT-6.1 Terra at max.

dropperFallbackModels._comment: Non-Cursor fallback for dropper on another provider.

_notes: Daily driver/session model: openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol, context window from pi --list-models: 272K.
compactAfterTokens: 180000 = fallback if the session model contextWindow is unavailable.

LOCAL PATCH ported to pi-blackhole 0.5.9: compactAfterPercent: 0.65 makes auto-compaction derive from the active model contextWindow and fall back to compactAfterTokens when absent; reapply after upgrades if lost. See ~/.pi/agent/pi-blackhole/LOCAL_PATCHES.md.
tailBehavior is pi-default only: blackhole still owns compaction, but Pi's gentler recent-tail cut is used.
midRunCompaction is explicitly off: turn_end compaction aborts the shared run signal and is unsafe with nested/background extensions. Compaction stays at agent_end.
fullFoldAlways keeps observations/reflections eligible on the first compaction before a prior full-fold boundary exists.
retainedToolOutputMaxTokens and recallResponseMaxChars are explicitly 0 to preserve the previous provider-visible tool-output and recall-output policies.

reflectionsPoolMaxTokens is explicitly 0 to preserve the previously uncapped reflection pool; showPreCompactionMessage, statusBar, and showWorkerNotifications are false to avoid new display surfaces and a second footer writer.
dropperPressureThreshold is 1 to disable 0.5.9's newly effective pool-pressure trigger without disabling normal dropper cadence or adding provider calls by default.
Worker primaries use openai-codex/gpt-6.1-terra with 500K context from the local model catalog: observer high, reflector high, and dropper max. The largest worker input cap remains 160K.

Historical GPT-5.6 Luna observer comparison: a three-sample comparison found it preserved the user's request in 3/3 chunks while cursor/grok-4.5 low missed it in 3/3, and Luna max was about 1.95x slower with 22% more memory output. The earlier dropper selection used a three-sample, six-model comparison for conservative pruning under low budget pressure.
Fallbacks use providers different from the OpenAI Codex worker primaries.
Final emergency fallback remains the session model because sessionFallback is true: openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.
2026-06-12: Disabled debug/debugLog after transient Cursor proxy debugging; worker/fallback cooldownHours remain 1 hour.

2026-10-16: Terra worker primaries use cooldownHours 0. Codex WebSocket drops are transport failures, not model faults, so a failure skips Terra only for the rest of that stage instead of benching it for an hour. Removed opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro fallbacks; Google Gemini Flash Lite is the only non-Codex fallback before the session model.
LOCAL PATCH 2026-08-09: preserve Pi 0.84.1 nullable ProviderHeaders for worker requests so null deletion markers remain effective.
